description: Six entry points. The first four are ON by default with a documented opt-out; the two pending-asks gate entries run in observe mode by default. SessionStart (compact|resume|clear|startup): control-anchor re-injection (compaction-survival); opt out with SESSION_WORKFLOW_ANCHOR_HOOKS=0. SessionStart (resume|compact): the stale skill-body check, read from the session transcript; one line per plugin whose last-served skill body came from an older cached version than the installed one, naming both versions and the fix; silent when every body is current or served from outside a plugin cache. Opt out with SESSION_WORKFLOW_STALE_BODY_CHECK=0. PostToolUse (Write|Edit|MultiEdit): a size warning when a write to an open anchor leaves its HEAD over the injection budget or within 10% of it, plus the self-ignoring .gitignore in the anchors directory; silent on every other write; it shares the SESSION_WORKFLOW_ANCHOR_HOOKS=0 opt-out. Stop: the feedback-debt nudge, read from the session transcript; it stays silent unless a feedback-targets file resolves, so an install with no registered tools never sees it. Opt out with SESSION_WORKFLOW_FEEDBACK_NUDGE=0. Every no-op path returns zero with no output. See the plugin README for the exact settings block each opt-out goes in. Pending-asks gate (two entry points sharing one script and one switch), in observe mode by default: UserPromptSubmit empties the per-session ledger when the prompt is owner-typed (a new turn; a task notification, subagent hand-back or peer message leaves it); Stop records the asks in last_assistant_message and, at a stop with nothing in flight, records the earlier asks of the turn the message dropped, once per ask, as an observed event; with SESSION_WORKFLOW_FINAL_BLOCK_GATE=on it also returns them as additionalContext in UTF-8 (never decision: block). Ledger under CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA/final-block-gate/. SESSION_WORKFLOW_FINAL_BLOCK_GATE=0 turns it off; `python hooks/final_block_gate.py --health` prints the counts.
